newsitem.title: GERMANY: German intervention board details EU sugar export.
newsitem.headline: German intervention board details EU sugar export.

text.p: A total 24,000 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 40.850 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at the weekly European Union tender on Wednesday, the German Intervention Board BLE said.
Out of the total, traders in France received 3,500 tonnes, in the UK received 7,000 and in Germany 13,500, BLE said.
This week's award brought the cumulative tonnage for export from the 1996/97 crop to 2.442 million tonnes.
This compared with the 2,350 tonnes awarded on July 17, 1996, when the cumulative tonnage totalled 2.506 million tonnes.
